name: Extinction-based Ambient Occlusion
definition: An approximation of ambient occlusion that models the attenuation of diffusely reflected ambient light through occlusion in a local neighborhood N(s) of a sample point s, using the sum of extinction coefficients rather than shadow ray tracing.
summary: Extinction-based Ambient Occlusion approximates ambient light attenuation by summing local extinction coefficients via a precomputed table, offering a fast alternative to ray tracing.
